original_hook: 🚨 Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub 📰 On-chain fiat reserves are surging as CoinDesk reports stablecoin wallets are openly challenging traditional bank accounts as consumer payment hubs. Yet $BTC remains locked in a tight 2.2% intraday compression near $78,909 on $1.43B spot volume. With corporate buyers like Strategy temporarily pausing direct spot buys to repurchase $176M of preferred shares, dry powder is stacking in stablecoins rather than immediately lifting spot market levels. The structural capital base is widening, but price requires active conversion off the sidelines to break out of this coil. Bullish, bearish, or wait Which asset is giving the clearest confirmation?
